acconeer_desc: Acconeer's vision is to be the world leader in small size, low cost, and low power consumption mmWave radar sensing for innovation and sustainability in high-volume products. Rooted in cutting-edge research and high-tech industry, with a passion for innovation and development, we are determined to create a major breakthrough in sensor technology. We work together, engaging the best talents in close collaboration with leading partners and customers around the world. We develop and produce our own mixed signal IC's, we design 60 GHz antennas and lenses, we use Python and C signal processing to detect anything you can imagine - from heart rate and breathing, stone sizes and water flows to forgotten babies and hand gestures - and we have fun while doing it. Does this sound interesting? Welcome to discuss your future with us – summer jobs and MSc thesis projects!
axis_desc: Axis creates innovative solutions that combine AI, cloud services, and advanced imaging technology to solve real challenges. Our products are used worldwide, from smart cities to industrial automation. Development ranges from intelligent cameras with deep learning algorithms to scalable cloud platforms that analyze and optimize complex systems in real time. Our focus is on creating sustainable, user-friendly solutions that make a difference, whether it's improving traffic flows, optimizing production processes, or securing critical infrastructure. If you're studying engineering physics, engineering mathematics, or engineering nanoscience, you're exactly what Axis is looking for! With us, you get the chance to work on important and complex projects, learn from industry-leading experts, and be part of a company that values creativity and innovation. We offer summer jobs, thesis projects, part-time jobs, and your first job as a recent graduate, perfect for those who want to combine studies with practical experience or take their first steps in their career. Visit our booth to learn more about us, our technology, and how you can get your foot in the door at Axis!
coherent_desc: Working at Coherent means being part of a cutting-edge global technology company. Coherent is one of the world's leading players in photonics, laser technology, and advanced materials, with around 35,000 employees in over 20 countries. Our solutions are used in everything from industrial manufacturing and semiconductors to medical technology, research, and communications. As an employee at Coherent, you get the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally in an organization that combines strong local commitment with international collaboration. We are currently looking for, among others, people with education in Nanoscience, Engineering Physics, Engineering Mathematics, and Materials Science.
ericsson_desc: As the inventors of mobile, Bluetooth and the evolution of all the Gs (3G, 4G 5G), Ericsson is behind many of the most significant communication breakthroughs our world has seen over the past nearly 150 years. And we are just getting started. Today, billions of people rely on us to communicate every day. Our technology improves lives, redefines how we work and helps drive a sustainable future. In the coming years, the next wave of mobile will reshape enterprises, unlock new network value and unleash innovation across sectors.
foi_desc: The Swedish Defence Research Agency (FOI) is a government agency that conducts world-leading research in defence and security to support Sweden's military and civil defence. With a focus on understanding, explaining, and changing, we provide new knowledge and expert support. Much of the work is done together with various allies within NATO. The research is applied both within defence agencies and among civilian actors and plays a crucial role in building relevant and effective defence capabilities. The activities span the entire total defence and include, among other things: Underwater, cyber defence, space, electronic warfare, sensor systems, civil defence, CBRNE (chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear and explosive substances), military platforms including weapons and protection, and security policy analyses. Most of our researchers and engineers have a technical background in physics, chemistry, electrical, computer, mechanical, energy or civil and water engineering. FOI is now expanding significantly and we are looking for engineers, researchers and thesis workers year-round, see foi.se.
if_desc: Being the Nordic region's largest insurance company requires constant analysis of large amounts of data and continuous improvement of models to stay at the forefront when it comes to both pricing and risk analysis. With several business areas and departments, there are many exciting roles for an engineer, so if you think statistics is fun and like to code, you should stop by - we're always looking for new analysts! Are you in year 3 or 4? Keep an eye out for our summer jobs! Are you at the end of your education? Feel free to apply to our trainee program! Interested in thesis work? Get in touch!
janestreet_desc: Jane Street is a quantitative trading firm with offices worldwide. We hire smart, humble people who love to solve problems, build systems, and test theories. Will our next great idea come from you?
nanolund_desc: NanoLund: The place to do Nanoscience and prepare for a career in academia or industry NanoLund is Sweden's largest research environment for interdisciplinary Nanoscience and nanotechnology. We are an international, highly visible nanoscience center that offers exceptional scientific opportunities, training, and career development. We do this through a strong culture of openness and by offering access to an incredibly wide range of capabilities within characterization, fabrication and modelling. NanoLund is built on a high degree of collaboration between research groups that span multiple disciplines. NanoLund will remain at the forefront of pioneering new research directions and contributing to high-quality Nanoscience and Nanotechnology at the international level. As a center NanoLund aspires to be an open and creative environment that encourages collaboration, mutual inspiration and support, the sharing of knowledge, and an open attitude and that offers ideal opportunities for education and career development. The 130 PhD students form 1/3 of NanoLund and are employed in engineering, natural sciences, and medicine. As a PhD student you will be embedded in an active research topic and trained in state-of-the-art technology and methods. As a PhD you will receive training in general research as well as leadership skills, get an introduction to our wide range of networks, and gain access to our mentorship program. After the PhD you continue in science or change to industry using the networks to find otherwise closed positions. A PhD with us opens many doors is much more than "just" another degree, it is the start of a career.
llc_desc: Lund Laser Centre (LLC, www.llc.lu.se) is an organization for interdisciplinary research in optics, spectroscopy, and lasers at Lund University. At LLC, there are over 300 laser systems distributed across over 35 research laboratories used by about 300 researchers from LTH, the Faculty of Science, and the Faculty of Medicine. Nearly half of these are PhD students and thesis workers, and at LLC's departments there are great opportunities for you who are interested in doing your thesis work or pursuing a PhD in both basic research and applied research using modern laser technology.
susquehanna_desc: Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.
linc_desc: LINC-STEM's role within LINC is to provide all our members, especially those within Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics the knowledge to take the step into finance. With the ever-progressing world of technology, students with these key technical skills are heavily sought after and this committee will provide you with both the tools and the network to establish a connection with a suitable employer. Throughout the year our committee organizes a wide variety of events such as the annual Hackathon: "A Day in the Life of a Trader", the Copenhagen Finance Tour, Python workshops, and more. Additionally, LINC-STEM plays a significant role in the Trading & Quantitative Research (TQR) teams of R&A, which recruit students at the start of each academic year. All of our events have the common goal of preparing our members with the valuable skill set that is vital when pursuing a career within finance.
welcome_to_farad: Welcome to FARAD—the career fair of the F-section. FARAD exists to serve as an information hub between the job market and students, offering you an opportunity to enhance your employer brand among our future engineers and to inform them about why your company is an attractive employer.
about_farad: Farad is the F-guild at LTH's career fair, where companies get the opportunity to get in touch with students from the programs Engineering Physics, Engineering Mathematics and Engineering Nanoscience.
extended_ads_in_the_guilds_medias: Extended advertising in the guild's media
lunch_lecture_desc: A lecture from 12:15 to 13:00 for approximately 150 students, where you get the chance to capture the interest of students in years 4–5 and introduce yourselves to students in years 1–3. We can confidently guarantee at least 70–100 students will attend.
student_session_desc: Before the fair, students can submit their CVs in an expression of interest for contact interviews with your company. You can then choose which applicants you want to interview. FARAD will then arrange a venue and contact the students. You can structure the contact meeting as you see fit and choose how many people you want to talk to during these two hours.
price_pdf_desc: You may find all of the different price plans that we offer you to choose from in the documents below.
main_sponsor_summary: A fully tailored package including, for example, a lunch lecture, case evening, or company visit.
company_host_summary: A company host who will help you with everything you might need, including assembly and disassembly
name: Name
contact_form_submitted: Thank you for your message! We will get back to you as soon as possible.
sittningsvard_desc: As a banquet host, you work at the formal dinners that FARAD organizes. We host a fun dinner in December and a banquet after the fair where we promise an amazing after-party! Perfect for you who want to try what it's like to work at a sitting!
foretagsvard_desc: As a company host, you get responsibility for a company during the fair day. You welcome them, help them during the day and are their contact person. You also help prepare for the fair and clean up afterwards. Perfect if you have a company you're particularly interested in and a great experience for your CV!
servicevard_desc: As a service host, you work in the lounge, wardrobe or at the information desk. In the lounge, you make sure that company representatives have everything they need, and at the information desk you help visitors find their way. You also help with preparations and follow-up work around the fair. Perfect for you who like service and want to build your experience!
student_session_desc_for_students: During the FARAD Career Fair, you will have a unique opportunity to get in touch with companies that interest you — and that are interested in you! Your details will be forwarded to the companies, who will contact you if they are interested in your profile. The companies will decide how the meeting will be held and will inform you in their email.
sustainalink_desc: Do you want to be part of transitioning to a sustainable future? Sustainalink creates opportunities for you as a student to do projects within sustainability at companies and organizations while you study. Whether you are just at the beginning of your education or about to write your thesis, you can gain knowledge, experience and inspiration to kickstart your career. Through our internships, thesis projects and short assignments at companies, municipalities and other organizations, you get the chance to make a difference and contribute with your knowledge. Read more and find our projects at sustainalink.se
triathlon_desc: Triathlon Group is a leading management consultancy, helping clients address critical management issues and delivering lasting, distinctive value by combining innovation with deep and extensive expertise. At Triathlon, we operate in the intersection of technology and business, working in close collaboration with both innovative startups and established global companies. Our assignments span key business functions such as product development, manufacturing, purchasing, and after market, as well as support functions including finance, IT, and quality. We typically work in joint teams together with our clients, ensuring not only strong delivery but also effective knowledge transfer to the client organization. Founded in 1994, Triathlon was built with the ambition to create a truly partner-owned management consultancy focused on long-term value creation. From the start, we have held a strong conviction that knowledge is the only sustainable source of competitive advantage. This commitment to excellence has enabled Triathlon to grow and evolve continuously over time. We are now recruiting for the entry-level position of Management Consultant, with start dates in spring or autumn 2026. In addition, we have opened a separate application track for students graduating in 2027, for those who are interested in an early dialogue with us. If you are an ambitious high performer looking to make a real impact, you might be exactly who we are looking for. Feel free to visit our booth at FARAD to participate in our competition, have a friendly chat with one of us from Triathlon or simply grab a coffee. We look forward to meeting you!
magma_desc: Founded in 2015, Magma was established with the goal of improving and personalizing mathematics education for students, teachers, principals, and school administrators. Today we collaborate with over 80% of Sweden's municipalities and are established in the USA, UK, and EMEA. Using AI and established partnerships with publishers, Magma has revolutionized mathematics education since its inception and improved goal achievement for its users. If you're interested in mathematics, machine learning, and AI, we're the place for you! We're actively seeking new stars for our team worldwide.
bigscience_desc: Big Science Sweden connects Swedish industry, academia, and research institutes with the major international research facilities, where groundbreaking science and technology development create new opportunities. We disseminate information about the facilities' exciting development and career opportunities for Swedish students and professionals. We work with, among others, CERN, ESS, ESO, FAIR, and ITER.
sveing_desc:
Sveriges Ingenjörer is a trade union for those studying or working as engineers. We support you during your studies and prepare you for your future career as an engineer.

For only SEK 15/month, you get affordable insurance, contract review, patent advice, access to scholarships, etc. You also get a discount on Kollin and access to Ny Teknik's digital premium service.

While you focus on your studies, we focus on you. Become a member at the fair and get SEK 100 off at ICA: [sverigesingenjorer.se/medlemskap](https://www.sverigesingenjorer.se/medlemskap/)
